name: tablejourney
description: Food travel data for Codex through TableJourney's hosted, read-only MCP server: hand-checked restaurants, cafes, markets and street food in 200+ cities, food festivals with resolved dates, signature dishes, itineraries, and bookable tours and stays. Includes the tablejourney-food-travel skill. No account, no API key.

interface.shortDescription: Where and what to eat in 200+ cities, and when the food festivals are
interface.longDescription: Ask where to eat, what to order and which food festivals are on during a trip. Answers come from TableJourney's hosted MCP server: venues checked by hand (each page shows its source, the date it was checked and its open status), festivals with their next resolved dates, signature dishes and day-by-day itineraries, plus bookable tours, tickets, stays and car hire. Read-only; no account, no API key. Booking links are affiliate links and are labelled as such.
defaultPrompt: Which food festivals are on in Italy in the next two months?
Find vegan places open now near the Pantheon in Rome.
What should I eat in Oaxaca, and where?
